ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible fluke surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized in specific regions providing a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast contiguous blobs are localized as: a singular white ring on the mid-left lobe; two large elliptical white blobs adjacent to the right side of the median notch; several circular rings on the mid-right lobe; and dense, chaotic white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 70 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys is highest on the outer distal margins and lower near the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lobes exhibit a convex leading edge trajectory from the peduncle transition, with the trailing edge following an irregular upward and outward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-like high-intensity pixel clusters detected: one on the left lobe, at least four distinct circular/ring shapes on the right lobe, and several smaller clusters near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible, particularly concentrated as parallel 'rake' marks on the upper margins and distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the trailing edge and dense scarring on the distal tips. Multiple circular depigmentation scars likely originating from sessile organisms are present across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dense swirling pattern of high-intensity white pixels is localized on the far right distal tip, distinct from the more isolated markings elsewhere.
